title: LangChain prompt-to-parser chain with current import paths
intent: Build a LangChain runnable chain from a chat prompt using langchain-core imports.
notes: A stand-in function plays the model, so no API key is needed. The check proves the import paths and the pipe composition still work.

files.check.py:
from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda

prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages(
    [("system", "You are terse."), ("human", "{question}")]
)
fake_model = RunnableLambda(
    lambda value: AIMessage(content="echo:" + value.to_messages()[-1].content)
)
chain = prompt | fake_model | StrOutputParser()
assert chain.invoke({"question": "hi"}) == "echo:hi"
print("strue-ok")

avoid.why: langchain.chains and LLMChain are no longer in the langchain package; compose runnables from langchain_core instead.
